prompt: In the core-infra channel, which messages were posted by someone who holds an admin role in our workspace, about the memory-pressure/outage response?
binding_note: The route requires a message in core-infra whose author is also a workspace member holding the 'admin' workspace-membership role. The two workspace admins (Robert Walsh, Morgan Freeman) are not members of core-infra and never posted there, while everyone who did post the outage discussion in core-infra holds only the 'member' workspace role, so no message satisfies the full chain.

obligations.name: admin_authored_incident_messages
obligations.description: Messages located in the core-infra channel whose author is a user holding an 'admin' workspace-membership role in the channel's workspace, concerning the outage/memory-pressure incident discussion
obligations.scope: core-infra channel messages authored by a workspace-admin-role member

task_spec.text: Identify which messages in core-infra were posted by a workspace admin discussing the memory-pressure/outage response, and report what they say.

access_plan: Use conversations.history on C_INFRA (core-infra) to enumerate the OOM/memory-pressure incident messages and their authors, then users.info on each distinct author to check their workspace-membership role; cross-reference conversations.members for core-infra against the workspace's admin-role holders (Robert Walsh, Morgan Freeman) via their own users.info records to confirm neither is a core-infra participant, establishing the empty intersection.
